output.content:
**Marvell Technology — Q1 FY2027 AI-data-center read-through** *(quarter ended May 2, 2026; results released May 27, 2026).* [[1]]

- Marvell reported record Q1 FY2027 revenue of **$2.418 billion**, up **28% year over year** and **9% sequentially**. [[2]]
- Data-center revenue was a record **$1.833 billion**, up **27% year over year** and **11% sequentially**; it represented roughly **76%** of company revenue. [[2]] [[3]]
- The remaining **communications and other** revenue was **$585.1 million**, up **29% year over year** and **3% sequentially**. [[4]] [[2]]
- Q1 profitability included a **52.1% GAAP gross margin**, **58.9% non-GAAP gross margin**, and **$0.80 non-GAAP diluted EPS**. [[5]]

**Custom AI silicon**

- Management said custom-silicon revenue remains on track to grow **more than 20% year over year in FY2027**, led by its flagship XPU program and additional XPU-attach ramps, including CXL and NIC products. [[3]]
- For FY2028, Marvell forecast custom revenue to grow **more than 100% year over year**, driven by multiple program ramps and several new custom design wins. [[2]]
- This implies the Q1 data-center performance was not dependent on a single product category: management reported sequential and annual growth across **optical interconnect, custom silicon, and switching**. [[3]]

**Electro-optics / interconnect**

- Marvell raised its FY2027 interconnect-revenue growth outlook to **more than 70% year over year**, making interconnect the principal source of the expected approximately **50% FY2027 data-center-revenue growth**. [[2]] [[3]]
- Demand cited by the company spans **800G and 1.6T scale-out optics**, **51.2T Ethernet scale-out switches**, scale-up optical solutions for **NPO/CPO**, and scale-across data-center-interconnect modules. [[4]]
- The scale-up-optics opportunity is expected to ramp strongly in FY2028, with revenue forecast to more than double versus the company’s prior **approximately $150 million** outlook. [[2]]
- Scale-out-switch revenue is forecast to exceed **$600 million in FY2027**, about double year over year, with a path to approximately **$1 billion in FY2028**. [[2]]

**Outlook and analytical takeaway**

- Marvell guided Q2 FY2027 revenue to **$2.700 billion ±5%** at the midpoint, or roughly **35% year-over-year growth**. [[4]]
- Management lifted FY2027 revenue expectations to nearly **$11.5 billion**, about **40% year-over-year growth**, and projected FY2028 revenue of approximately **$16.5 billion**, about **45% growth** and roughly **$1.5 billion above** its prior FY2028 outlook. [[3]] [[2]]
- The central investment message is that Marvell’s AI exposure is broadening from custom XPU silicon into the connectivity stack—high-speed optical interconnect, scale-out and scale-up switching, CPO/NPO optics, and XPU-attached CXL/NIC silicon—which supports management’s raised FY2027–FY2028 outlook. [[4]] [[2]]
